summary: Kanzhun Ltd filed a Form 6-K attaching a Hong Kong Next Day Disclosure Return detailing share buybacks for cancellation and a small equity issuance. Between March 20 and April 13, 2026, the company repurchased multiple tranches of Class A ordinary shares at prices ranging from ~$6.57 to $6.82 per share, totaling over 10 million shares. On June 2, 2026, it issued 34,600 new shares at $3.19 per share upon exercise of share options. The buybacks represent a significant capital return program, reducing share count. The filing is routine disclosure under HK Listing Rules; watch for continued buyback pace and eventual cancellation of repurchased shares.
